Name: Chimham
Summary: Chimham was associated with Barzillai the Gileadite, who asked David to let Chimham cross the Jordan and live at court in his place when Barzillai himself was too old to go to Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Chimham crossed over to David's court in the place of the aged Barzillai.
LifeLesson: Going in another's place is its own quiet honour.
